Explanation: The analysis is based on the available EduPro dataset and may not represent all online learners or education platforms.
The study identifies patterns and relationships but does not establish causal relationships.
The dataset does not contain examination scores, completion rates, assessment results or learning gains.
Income, socioeconomic status and household-level information are not available.
Detailed geographic information such as district, rural/urban status and state-level participation is not available.
Disability and accessibility-related learner data are not included.
The dataset does not establish whether course participation resulted in employment or income gains.
Findings should not automatically be generalized to the entire population without representative sampling and additional datasets.
Observed temporal patterns depend on the date range contained in the dataset.
Enrollment behavior may reflect learner self-selection and therefore may not represent the preferences of non-participating learners.
